lessons.claim: Single-realisation scatter of the fitted f_c, measured on exact OU at the archived trap run's estimator configuration: 9.12 % sd per bead at T_obs/tau_k = 2000, and 28.10 % sd at T_obs/tau_k = 310 (AM's 5 s per rung). The ensemble of 250 traces gives 0.43 % and 1.81 % respectively, so the ratio is 21.1x and 15.5x -- NOT sqrt(1000) = 31.6x as r2 finding[3] stated, because f_c is fitted to the PSD of the n_trace = min(250, N) subset and averaging PSDs before a non-linear fit is not averaging fits.
